title: anthyllis alpestris f. pallidiflora
intro: Anthyllis alpestris f. pallidiflora, commonly known as alpine kidney vetch, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the legume family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include wound healing, antiseptic, and antiphlogistic properties, which may help soothe skin irritations and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of alpine kidney vetch include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
